decisions.reason: The same-message Event already records the integrated-board constraints owned by this Requirement; J_BAT placement is independently owned by the source Requirement and should not be duplicated.
The source changes J_BAT placement for the integrated-board context and does not modify or remove the historical modular power-board layout.
The source concerns the integrated board and does not change the modular main-board mechanical layout.
The integrated-board battery-connector placement does not alter the sensor-board mounting or connector-layout requirements.
J_BAT placement on the integrated board does not change the electrical definitions or pinouts of the modular interboard interfaces.
The battery-connector placement does not change the ESP32 module selection, pin breakout, or breakout pitch; antenna placement is already owned by the integrated mechanical-layout Requirement.
Moving J_BAT to a short edge does not change the AXP2101 electrical power path or charging behavior.
The mechanical placement of J_BAT does not alter the standalone USB regulator, activation condition, or powered load.
The source does not change the panel-mounted power-button connector or its PWRON behavior.
The enclosure Requirement already requires fitting the finalized board and connector layout; the source adds no contradictory or independently necessary enclosure-state change.
The source specifies connector placement only and does not change component sourcing, availability, or cost policy.
The source's mechanical USB-C placement clause does not change native USB enumeration or programming behavior, and the J_BAT change is unrelated.
